title: People's Republic of China CAC Algorithmic, Deep Synthesis, and Generative AI Regulatory Trilogy
stage_label: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services
summary: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (jointly issued by CAC, NDRC, MoE, MOST, MIIT, MPS, NRTA) governing public-facing foundation and generative AI services, training data IP and personal information compliance, accuracy/reliability duties, and tiered regulation excluding internal R&D.
